text:
Leafy Plus is $59/year and auto-renews, but it **doesn't include free Express shipping**. It gives free Standard shipping with no minimum, so if Express is your main reason, it won't meet that need.

On refunds: you get a full refund if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any benefits. If you've used a benefit, there's no refund, though your benefits continue to the end of the paid year.

Other perks include free change-of-mind returns, a 90-day guarantee, 10% off pots and accessories, and early access to rare plant drops. Whether it's worth it depends on how much you'd use those, but I can't speak to savings beyond what's listed here.
